notes: This event folder deliberately does NOT contain a populated ward-level damage_record table. Every source reachable in this session (WebSearch snippets only -- data.humdata.org, reliefweb.int, icimod.org, nrcs.org, en.wikipedia.org, and other primary/secondary sources were all blocked by this session's network egress policy) gave only national or multi-district aggregate figures, never a ward- or even district-level breakdown for Rasuwa specifically. Publishing those national totals as if they belonged to Timure or Syabrubesi would misattribute a national toll to two named wards -- exactly what METHODOLOGY.md section 7 (no data vs. zero, no silent imputation) prohibits. See README.md in this folder for what is needed to populate real damage_record rows.
